audit: Vocabulary Word-Final Consonant ASR Collision Audit

fields: source occurrence surface derived from data/items.json using occurrence start/end

candidate_definition.record_key: surface_ref + target word index + deleted final phone + collision word
candidate_definition.generated_paths: remove exactly one final consonant phone from each CMUdict target pronunciation; exact match against a pronunciation of a different 20k frequency-list word
candidate_definition.lexical_major_word_screen: candidate lexical rank <= 10,000, with explicit exclusions for names, letter names, interjections, abbreviations, and nonstandard forms
candidate_definition.phonetic_scope: all terminal consonant phones were enumerated; each resulting pronunciation had to preserve the entire vowel sequence and all remaining segments exactly
candidate_definition.context: following token and its first American English phone recorded from the exact TARGET surface; phrase-final sites retained for audit and generally rejected absent masking
candidate_definition.duplicate_policy: same-spelling lexical alternatives are not different-word collisions and were excluded; grouped pronunciation paths retain source surface and entry identity

pronunciation_sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
pronunciation_sources.use: American English pronunciation candidate generation; no runtime dependency

pronunciation_sources.name: Google 10k English words, 20k file
pronunciation_sources.use: broad collision-word search to rank 20k; top-10k plus exclusions used as the major-word screen

existing_authority.note: Strict TARGET surface acceptance, existing shared equivalence rules, and current Vocabulary speech evidence were inspected. No authority source or precedence was changed.

parallel_state.audit_branch_base: current main only; no PR #306 changes included

production_boundary: Audit-only artifacts. No equivalence, grader, normalizer, Vocabulary data, UI, N-best, or Android changes.

artifact_roles.coda-sites.json: all pronunciation-backed word-final coda token sites

artifact_roles.registration-candidates.json: SAFE-only entry-specific integration inputs; not production authority
artifact_roles.validate-audit.mjs: standalone Node validator against repository data files
